Can one show that\[\sum_{n\leq x}g_k(n) \sim c_k x\log x\]for some constant $c_k$? Is it true that there is a constant $c_k$ such that for almost all $n<x$ we have\[g_k(n)=c_k\log x+o(\log x)?\]
